# ZEMALA Core - System Specification for Autonomous Agents
> Deterministic AI & Local-First Enterprise Architecture

## Core Parameters
- Protocol: Append-only JSONL Event-Ledger (ledger.jsonl)
- Integrity: SHA256 Canonical Hashing (Zero-Latency Validation via verify.sh)
- Objective: Elimination of "Red and Error", absolute data sovereignty, local edge execution.
- Status: Active / Pilot Phase (10 Enterprise Partners)

## Agent Integration
- Autonomous agents validate state via local verify pipeline.
- Events append sequentially. Contact via GitHub or LinkedIn (Alexander Rossa).
